mapper.select: SELECT e.subject_id AS subjectId, s.code AS code, s.name AS name, s.direction AS direction, COALESCE(SUM(e.debit), 0) AS debitTotal, COALESCE(SUM(e.credit), 0) AS creditTotal FROM t_voucher_entry e INNER JOIN t_voucher v ON v.id = e.voucher_id AND v.deleted = 0 INNER JOIN t_subject s ON s.id = e.subject_id AND s.deleted = 0 WHERE e.deleted = 0 AND v.status = 'POSTED' AND v.period = #{period} AND s.code LIKE '6%' AND (s.code <> '4103') GROUP BY e.subject_id, s.code, s.name, s.direction -- 只保留借贷净额非零的科目：净额为 0 说明本期已自动对冲，无可结转余额， -- 纳入结转凭证会生成一对抵消分录（借收入/贷本年利润 + 借本年利润/贷收入），纯粹噪音 HAVING ABS(COALESCE(SUM(e.debit), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(e.credit), 0)) <> 0 ORDER BY e.subject_id ASC
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO t_voucher_entry (id, voucher_id, subject_id, debit, credit, summary, assist_json, sort_order) VALUES
(#{item.id}, #{item.voucherId}, #{item.subjectId}, #{item.debit}, #{item.credit}, #{item.summary}, #{item.assistJson}::jsonb, #{item.sortOrder})
